source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of performance metrics (PDF 143).

items: Error metrics: andaza asal qeemat se kitna mukhtalif hai. Grocery model 8,000 rupay kahe aur asal bill 10,000 ho to ghalti 2,000 rupay.
Accuracy metrics: kitne andaze durust the. Pass/fail model mein accuracy yeh hai ke kitni baar sahi tha.

blocks.prompt: Pass/fail model 20 andaze lagata hai aur 17 durust hain. Accuracy kya hai?

items: Error metrics sach se faasla naapte; accuracy metrics durust andaze ginte hain.
